production: JummBox native score authoring, unmodified official Synth float32 rendering, then static gain / 30Hz highpass / edge fades
listening_review: No subjective listening performed; numerical and score-level QC only

sounds.title: Intellectual · Logic Pin / 論理ピン
sounds.intended_role: Compact confirmation of a small connection; frequent repeat use
sounds.description: A dry tuned-glass tick locks onto a quiet low support; two precisely spaced contact details give an analytical, compact signature.

sounds.title: Intellectual · Logic Gate / 論理ゲート
sounds.intended_role: A clearly denser and fuller medium connection
sounds.description: Three measured glass gates rise in a consonant pattern above a deeper latch. Added events and a longer body communicate connection growth.

sounds.title: Intellectual · Proof Complete / 証明完了
sounds.intended_role: A substantial completed connection with short controlled resolution
sounds.description: A lower tuned mechanism, octave glass body and four-step resolving computation build a short, assured completion. Weight comes from harmonic layers and time, not gain alone.

sounds.title: Intellectual · Shattered Axiom / 公理の破断
sounds.intended_role: Damage spread through geometric vertices or multiple connections
sounds.description: Four alternating polygon vertices fracture in a precise interval pattern; a descending glass bed ties the corners into a single damaged geometric structure.

sounds.title: Intellectual · Vector Pierce / ベクトル貫通
sounds.intended_role: Immediate focused contact or piercing beam on one target
sounds.description: A single focused lens snap and fast descending FM needle hit immediately, with a dry low puncture and no geometric arpeggio.

sounds.title: Ember Pop
sounds.intended_role: link_small
sounds.description: 小さい火種が乾いて弾ける

sounds.title: Flame Bite

sounds.description: 燃焼のふくらみと二つの火花

sounds.title: Fire Bloom

sounds.title: Flame Jet

sounds.title: Crystal Lattice

sounds.title: Icicle Point
sounds.intended_role: direct_damage
sounds.description: 尖った氷柱の接触、短い硬質破裂

sounds.title: Thunder · Spark Latch / 放電ラッチ
sounds.intended_role: Compact confirmation of a small connection; frequent repeat use
sounds.description: One tiny electrical crack attaches to a short dark charge pulse. The crack is filtered and ends quickly, leaving a compact rounded electrical body.

sounds.title: Thunder · Double Arc / 二重アーク
sounds.intended_role: A clearly denser and fuller medium connection
sounds.description: Two fast current contacts feed a fuller transformer-like body, with a short low rumble. The second arc is quieter and delayed rather than a louder copy.

sounds.title: Thunder · Storm Circuit / 雷撃回路
sounds.intended_role: A substantial completed connection with short controlled resolution
sounds.description: A strong opening strike resolves through three descending electrical contacts and a rounded, short rumble. Added low body and staged aftershocks supply scale without sustained harsh noise.

sounds.title: Thunder · Branching Fault / 分岐放電
sounds.intended_role: Damage spread through geometric vertices or multiple connections
sounds.description: Three short arcs jump between connected vertices while a lower branch collapses underneath. Alternating placement and pitch make a geometric electrical failure distinct from one direct strike.

sounds.title: Thunder · Needle Bolt / 一閃雷撃
sounds.intended_role: Immediate focused contact or piercing beam on one target
sounds.description: A single concentrated electric spike drops into a dry low hit. Noise is restricted to the opening 50 ms and the remainder is a sharply damped native FM body.

sounds.title: Shade Knock
sounds.intended_role: link_small
sounds.description: 暗い空洞を短く叩く

sounds.title: Shade Fold
sounds.intended_role: link_medium
sounds.description: 空洞が内側へ二段で折れる

sounds.title: Void Collapse
sounds.intended_role: link_large
sounds.description: 重い空洞がつぶれ、低中域の余波だけが残る

sounds.title: Shadow Seal
sounds.intended_role: shape_damage
sounds.description: 三点の不穏な印が一つの封印へ閉じる

sounds.title: Void Needle
sounds.intended_role: direct_damage
sounds.description: 一点へ吸い込む低い鋭さ、短い空洞接触

sounds.title: Light · Lumen Pin / 光のピン
sounds.intended_role: Compact confirmation of a small connection; frequent repeat use
sounds.description: A soft radiant-metal ping has a clear muted contact underneath. A near-pure upper partial gives light without a piercing hiss or long bell tail.

sounds.title: Light · Halo Join / 光輪結合
sounds.intended_role: A clearly denser and fuller medium connection
sounds.description: Two offset luminous chimes share a stronger warm-metal contact. A lower sustained resonant body adds substance while the second ray extends the connection.

sounds.title: Light · Radiant Crown / 光冠完成
sounds.intended_role: A substantial completed connection with short controlled resolution
sounds.description: A full warm strike opens into a gently voiced radiant crown, with three short rays and an octave lower support. The major-sixth color is luminous; its native envelopes close before the half-second tail.

sounds.title: Light · Broken Prism / 光の多面破断
sounds.intended_role: Damage spread through geometric vertices or multiple connections
sounds.description: A prism breaks across four brief metallic rays with alternating interval colors. The impact stays solid below the delicate top, distinguishing a damaged luminous shape from a reward chime.

sounds.title: Light · Photon Point / 光子穿撃
sounds.intended_role: Immediate focused contact or piercing beam on one target
sounds.description: A focused bright-metal point lands instantly and sweeps down into a warm contact. Soft high-frequency filtering keeps the luminous beam from becoming an abrasive laser squeal.

sounds.title: Machine · Gear Click / ギア結合
sounds.intended_role: Compact confirmation of a small connection; frequent repeat use
sounds.description: Two dry gear teeth fall into a small metallic socket. A compact servo grain colors the mechanism without an extended mechanical loop.

sounds.title: Machine · Ratchet Lock / ラチェット固定
sounds.intended_role: A clearly denser and fuller medium connection
sounds.description: Three ratchet teeth lead into a wider metal latch with a low geared body. The added sequential mechanism and body depth signal the medium connection.

sounds.title: Machine · Core Assembly / 機構組み上げ
sounds.intended_role: A substantial completed connection with short controlled resolution
sounds.description: A heavy mounting thud, three staged gear catches and a final locking plate form a miniature assembly. Its deeper body and multiple mechanisms make the large event distinct from the smaller ratchet.

sounds.title: Machine · Lattice Buckle / 機械格子の座屈
sounds.intended_role: Damage spread through geometric vertices or multiple connections
sounds.description: Four linked frame corners shear in alternating directions while the metal frame buckles down. The structured damage sequence suggests several connected mechanical edges.

sounds.title: Machine · Piston Strike / ピストン直撃
sounds.intended_role: Immediate focused contact or piercing beam on one target
sounds.description: One centered piston and a short steel faceplate snap strike at the same instant. A very short servo return adds mechanical identity without a multi-hit damage pattern.

sounds.title: Space · Vacuum Pin / 真空ピン
sounds.intended_role: Compact confirmation of a small connection; frequent repeat use
sounds.description: A compact warped FM body scoops down into a dark orbital ring, with a soft hollow contact. It feels like a tiny gravitational fastening rather than a conventional musical ping.

sounds.title: Space · Orbit Coupling / 軌道結合
sounds.intended_role: A clearly denser and fuller medium connection
sounds.description: Two folded orbital contacts couple to a low vacuum body. The second ring reverses its small pitch warp, adding depth and movement while remaining centered and dry.

sounds.title: Space · Gravity Seal / 重力封合
sounds.intended_role: A substantial completed connection with short controlled resolution
sounds.description: A dense gravitational transient drops under two slowly folding orbital rings and a darker return impact. The body develops in stages and the vacuum texture stays brief and softly filtered.

sounds.title: Space · Warped Polygon / 歪曲多角形
sounds.intended_role: Damage spread through geometric vertices or multiple connections
sounds.description: Four orbiting nodes bend in alternating pitch directions and fall into a collapsing low plane. This is a multi-point spatial rupture, with narrow stereo placement that survives mono playback.

sounds.title: Space · Singularity Lance / 特異点穿撃
sounds.intended_role: Immediate focused contact or piercing beam on one target
sounds.description: A single dark lance contracts a wide interval into a sharp gravitational punch. All layers begin immediately; the hollow snap is short and there are no orbiting follow-up notes.

loudness_method: First 100ms RMS and true peak; integrated LUFS is not used as a comparative target for sub-second one-shots.
